description: This file contains the implementation of serializers for abstract types in the Orleans serialization framework, including generic and non-generic serializers handling abstract classes and interfaces.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer<TField>
classes.description: A generic serializer for abstract types, implementing IFieldCodec and IBaseCodec interfaces, handling the serialization and deserialization of abstract classes and interfaces.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializerWrapper<TField>
classes.description: A sealed wrapper class for AbstractTypeSerializer, providing implementations for the serialization methods with class-type constraints.

classes.name: AbstractTypeSerializer
classes.description: The base non-generic serializer class handling core logic for abstract type serialization, including writing and reading fields with type considerations.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field of the abstract type, handling null references and delegating serialization to specific codecs based on runtime type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value of the abstract type from the reader, handling reference fields and delegating to specific codecs.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Placeholder virtual method for serializing an instance of the abstract type, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into an existing instance of the abstract type, consuming the end of the object/structure from the reader.

methods.name: ThrowMissingFieldType
methods.description: Throws an exception when the expected field type is missing during deserialization.
